title: Cart Checkout Navigation

sections.name: Checkout
items: On the cart page, Brava now recognizes Check Out buttons even when their text spans lines or the button is fixed to the screen.
Cart navigation no longer mistakes Continue Shopping for the checkout action.
If the cart still cannot advance, the task log distinguishes a failed checkout click from a missing control and reports safe cart-control details.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
